artBrief: **Cozy storybook.** A round magical cat curls around a book beside a steaming cup; a little flame floats above its tail. Calm amber window light.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Cozy storybook. A round magical cat curls around a book beside a steaming cup; a little flame floats above its tail. Calm amber window light. Keep this explicitly a magical CAT companion, not the app mascot. Round sleeping cat, curled tail, open book and one cup; warm amber window, muted plum and cream palette.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
